aggregation: ADE is mean Euclidean error across the 12 future positions per window, then mean across windows; FDE is error at prediction step 12, then mean across windows. Cross-seed standard deviations are population standard deviations.

constant_velocity.aggregation: Compute ADE per window as the mean Euclidean distance across its 12 positions; compute FDE per window at position 12; average each metric equally over windows.
constant_velocity.distance_units: raw dataset coordinate units; physical units unverified
